title: Mechanism survival: about half of testable ideas hold up
headline_insight: Only about half of testable mechanisms survive -- overall survival rate is 0.5039 across 256 testable hypotheses.
what_it_means: Of 287 hypotheses in the four sport ledgers, 256 were testable and 129 confirmed on their latest verdict, a 50.4% survival rate. Survival splits by sport: NBA holds up best at 0.56 while MLB is weakest at 0.3974.
how_to_read: Survival is the share of TESTABLE hypotheses whose latest verdict is confirmed or replicated; not-testable rows are excluded from the denominator.
why_it_matters: A survival rate near 50% across four independent sports is what an honest search looks like, neither everything confirming (overfit) nor nothing confirming (no signal at all).
caveat: Category-level rates on tiny samples are not durable: rest_fatigue survives at just 0.3056 and weather_park at 0.0 on a single testable row.
